*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: /Users/divadbaroon/Projects/Dynamite/dynamite/plot_umap.py
+import json
+import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
+import numpy as np
+import pandas as pd
+import umap
+from dynamite.cluster import embed, cluster
+
+posts = [json.loads(l) for l in open("data/posts.jsonl")]
+X = embed(posts); lab = cluster(X, 15)
+xy = umap.UMAP(n_neighbors=30, min_dist=0.1, metric="cosine", random_state=42).fit_transform(X)  # fixed seed: same plot every run
+names = pd.read_csv("data/cluster_labels_final.csv").set_index("cluster").final_label
+fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8, 7))
+ax.scatter(*xy[lab == -1].T, s=3, c="#dddddd", label="noise")
+ax.scatter(*xy[lab >= 0].T, s=4, c=lab[lab >= 0], cmap="tab20", alpha=0.8)
+for k in pd.Series(lab[lab >= 0]).value_counts().index[:12]:
+    cx, cy = np.median(xy[lab == k], axis=0)
+    ax.annotate(names[k], (cx, cy), fontsize=8, ha="center", bbox=dict(boxstyle="round,pad=0.2", fc="white", alpha=0.8, lw=0))
+ax.set_axis_off(); fig.tight_layout(); fig.savefig("figures/umap_clusters.png", dpi=200)
*** End Patch
